entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi Sarah... I hope you can help. I need to return something, but I'm worried it's been too long.
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I get your name and order number, please?
Yes, it's David Miller. Order number is VF77812. It's about the cycling shoes I bought.
Okay, David, I see the order here for the ProGlide cycling shoes. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Are they damaged, or is it more of a preference issue?

It's just... they're not working for me. I've tried everything. I've adjusted the cleats a dozen times, but every single ride I just get terrible blisters. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years, and I saved up for these. I'm just so disappointed.
I'm very sorry to hear that the shoes are causing blisters and aren't comfortable for you. Let me check the return eligibility for you. One moment.
Please, I really hope you can. With the holidays coming up, I could really use the money back. I just feel awful about this.
Okay, David, I've pulled up our policy. It looks like you received the shoes 85 days ago, and our standard return window is 90 days. So you are still well within the timeframe to return them.
Oh, really? That's... that's a huge relief. So I can get a full refund?

Yes, absolutely. We can definitely process a full refund for you once we receive the item back. I'm sending a prepaid return label to the email address on your account right now. You should see it in the next few minutes.
Wow. Thank you, Sarah. You have no idea how much I appreciate this. You've really helped me out today.
You're very welcome, David. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
